note: Counts and dates for what each NDJSON file in this directory holds. CI cross-checks these numbers against the file and against the built index, so a drop that lost records fails the publish instead of quietly shipping.

wordpress.coverageNote: browse=new is the only sort that enumerates the directory exactly; browse=popular ties on active_installs and yields 50,126 distinct slugs of a claimed 64,947. Duplicates come from plugins added mid-run shifting the offsets, which repeats records rather than skipping them.
